nodes.description: Owner address of the contract, set to msg.sender in constructor and mutated by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
Address that has been nominated to become the new owner and can claim ownership.
Immutable address of the target contract that receives delegated calls.
Mapping of user to function selector to whether the user may invoke that selector.
Boolean flag that opens submitBlocks access to everyone.
Mapping of exchange address to staked LRC amount.
Merkle root of the off-chain balance state used for withdrawals.
Owner-only function that transfers ownership to newOwner, guarded by onlyOwner.
Overridden owner-only function that sets pendingOwner instead of owner.
Pending owner only function that finalizes ownership transfer, guarded by onlyPendingOwner.
Forwards arbitrary data to target via low-level call after access check.
Owner-only function granting or revoking selector permissions.
View that returns whether user equals owner or has explicit selector permission.
Transfers ETH or ERC20 balance out of the contract after canDrain authorization.
Submits blocks to target with optional receiver callbacks and access check.
Owner-only toggle of the open flag.
ERC1271 signature validation based on recovered signer access rights.
Registers an on-chain forced withdrawal request, charges ETH fee and refunds surplus.
Withdraws a pending deposit after its age exceeds the configured bound.
Internal transfer helper that calls depositContract.withdraw and updates bookkeeping.
Attempts a token transfer and records amounts withdrawable on failure.
Sends ETH to an address via call with a configurable gas limit.
Low-level call forwarding value and calldata to a target address.
Performs a low-level token.call for transfer and checks the returned value.
Authorization check for drain based on drain selector permission.
Caller address, used for authorization decisions and refunds.
Block timestamp used for withdrawal expiry and deposit maturity checks.
Low-level call to target executing arbitrary calldata with msg.value.
External call forwarding decompressed calldata to the exchange target.
External ETH transfer with configurable gas that can invoke a receive/fallback.
External call to an untrusted ERC20 token contract.
Assembly calldatacopy loop reading caller-controlled calldata lengths.
External call to depositContract.withdraw inside try/catch, may invoke arbitrary logic.
Address parameter for the new owner in Ownable.transferOwnership.
Address parameter for the pending owner in Claimable.transferOwnership.
User address whose permission is being modified in grantAccess.
Function selector being granted or revoked in grantAccess.
Recipient address for the drained funds.
Expected owner of the account for the forced withdrawal.
Account ID in the Merkle tree for which a forced withdrawal is requested.
Resolved token ID used to index pending forced withdrawals.

edges.reason: onlyOwner resolves msg.sender against owner to gate ownership transfer.
onlyPendingOwner compares msg.sender to pendingOwner before claiming.
withAccess modifier checks hasAccessTo(msg.sender, selector) before delegating call.
drain requires canDrain(msg.sender, token) to authorize fund removal.
hasAccessTo compares the caller with owner and the permissions mapping.
grantAccess is owner-only and modifies permission state for a user.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks checks hasAccessTo(msg.sender, SUBMITBLOCKS_SELECTOR) or open flag.
block.timestamp is stored as the forced withdrawal request timestamp.
block.timestamp controls whether a deposit has matured for withdrawal.
block.timestamp is written to protocolFeeLastWithdrawnTime on successful transfer.
transferOwnership reads owner for the guard and writes the new owner value.
claimOwnership reads pendingOwner and promotes it to owner.
drain authorization via canDrain resolves through hasAccessTo against owner.
transact forwards calldata to the configured target address.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks sends decompressed data to the exchange target.
grantAccess writes the permissions mapping for user and selector.
hasAccessTo reads permissions[user][selector] to decide authorization.
the open flag can bypass the selector permission check in submitBlocksWithCallbacks.
transact performs a low-level call to target passing msg.value and data.
submitBlocksWithCallbacks performs fastCallAndVerify to the target with remaining gas.
forceWithdraw refunds fee surplus to msg.sender via sendETHAndVerify.
safeTransferWithGasLimit calls an untrusted token address with a gas limit.
drain sends ETH to the recipient via sendETHAndVerify before returning.
sendETH executes a value-bearing call to a user-supplied recipient.
fastCall performs the low-level call used by fastCallAndVerify.
transferTokens calls S.depositContract.withdraw with a caller-supplied gas limit.
distributeWithdrawal delegates the actual transfer to transferTokens.
withdrawFromDepositRequest transfers the matured deposit via transferTokens.
forceWithdraw resolves the tokenID used by withdrawal bookkeeping via getTokenID.
isValidSignature uses hasAccessTo on the recovered signer to validate ERC1271 signatures.
canDrain checks hasAccessTo(drainer, drain.selector) for the drain authorization.
openAccessToSubmitBlocks writes the open flag controlling external access.
decompressed calldata from assembly parsing flows into the delegated call data.
forceWithdraw sends the ETH fee surplus back to msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner only feeds the owner assignment inside Ownable.transferOwnership.
Parameter newOwner is exclusively used to set pendingOwner in Claimable.transferOwnership.
User address is only used as the permissions mapping key in grantAccess.
Selector is only used to index the permissions mapping in grantAccess.
Recipient address is only used as the transfer destination inside drain.
Owner parameter is only stored into the pending forced withdrawal entry.
Account ID is only used to index and bound-check the forced withdrawal request.
Local tokenID is derived and consumed entirely within forceWithdraw.
